title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Back-End Engineer | Specialist (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back-End Engineer | Specialist (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments. In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines. Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency. Participate in change management and project planning activities. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system. Requirements 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience. MUST BE fluent in English. Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management. Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management. Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting. Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues. Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions. Preferred Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects. Experience with enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis. Responsibilities: Manage large amounts of incoming tickets. Provide support to answer inquiries on products. Accept and handle technical requests. Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams. Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools. Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication. Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits;
follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents. Take the extra mile to engage customers. Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager. Skills And Qualifications: A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field. 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion. Possess an attention to detail. Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics. Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs. Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills. Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT. Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce). Why Join JoVE? A competitive compensation package. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Assessor Pedagógico Pnld
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assessor Pedagógico Pnld em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Salesforce Tpm Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Tpm Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD. Required Skills & Experience - 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.
- Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.
- Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.
- Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.
- Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability. Nice to Have Skills & Experience - CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.
- Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).
- AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).
- Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.G., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).
- Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks. Job Description The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.
- Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.
- Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.
- Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.
- Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.” - Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions;
escalate with context and options, not just problems.
- Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.
- Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.
- Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake).
- Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.
- Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.
- Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.
- Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional. Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas, CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments. In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines. Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency. Participate in change management and project planning activities. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system. Requirements 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience. MUST BE fluent in English. Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management. Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management. Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting. Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues. Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions. Preferred Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects. Experience with enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

description:

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments. In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines. Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency. Participate in change management and project planning activities. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system. Requirements 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience. MUST BE fluent in English. Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management. Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management. Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting. Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues. Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions. Preferred Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects. Experience with enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado deTítulo de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O seu papel: Como Designer Pleno, você será responsável pela execução técnica de diversas peças de marketing para múltiplos canais (Digital e Impresso). Também deverá trabalhar de forma colaborativa e proativa com os diretores de arte e designers em um ambiente de trabalho multifacetado, com ritmo acelerado e orientado a prazos. Suas responsabilidades: Criação, desdobramento e ajustes de materiais digitais e impressos com base em conceitos aprovados (.PSDs em camadas, .INDD, arquivos PDF interativos e preparação de arquivos digitais de acordo com as especificações do desenvolvedor). Realizar redimensionamentos e adaptações de peças digitais e impressas. Redesenhar materiais com base em Guias de Marca e estilo. Criar arquivos finais e documentos que estejam prontos para impressão. Executar as demandas de acordo com o direcionamento de prioridades e garantir que a execução é feita no tempo necessário com a maior assertividade possível, diminuindo rodadas de ajustes. Participar de treinamentos para entender processos e metodologias de trabalho. Requisitos necessários: Bacharelado em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. + de 2 anos atuando na área de Design. Conhecimento completo de Adobe inDesign, Ilustrador e Photoshop. Experiência com XD, Type Design, Sketch e Figma. Conhecimento em aplicações emergentes será um diferencial. Ter trabalhado em agências de Publicidade ou produtoras gráficas. Inglês Avançado (leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e conversação) --- Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas! Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar? We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar! Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena. About the Role The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases. Key Responsibilities Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions Support on site workshops as required Required Skills & Experience Spanish nice to have Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources Experience working in multi vendor delivery models Spanish language skills strongly preferred Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage, Competent with Python Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for people with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodation made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodation once hired. All applicants must be legally authorized to work with Zensar. Visa sponsorship may be available for qualified applicants for certain positions. Zensar values your privacy. We’ll use your data in accordance with our privacy statement located at:

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors. Intro video: Responsibilities Backlog & Kanban Management: Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members. Task Definition & Refinement: Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks. Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output: After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics. Qualifications Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively. Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities. Prior experience in a similar role is preferred. Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required Notes This is a full-time remote position. Hiring interviews are online.

title: Customer Onboarding Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Onboarding Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals. We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role. What You’ll Own: Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.) Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding. Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Gerente De Ehs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente De Ehs em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Newell Brands, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa líder global em bens de consumo, com mais de 50 marcas icônicas que podem ser encontradas em lares ao redor do mundo, incluindo Oster®, Cadence®, NUK®, Lillo®, Invicta®, Contigo®, Coleman®, Rubbermaid®, PaperMate®, Sharpie®, Graco® entre outras. Estamos em uma jornada para fortalecer nossas marcas e encantar os consumidores, contando com pessoas como você para trazer perspectivas únicas e brilhar em um ambiente dinâmico. Você fará parte de uma cultura colaborativa, solidária e respeitosa, onde valorizamos a diversidade e a singularidade de cada pessoa, reconhecendo que diferentes visões ampliam nossa capacidade de inovar e gerar impacto. Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é garantir processos justos e um ambiente inclusivo, onde talento e protagonismo sejam os verdadeiros critérios de crescimento. Cargo: Gerente de EHS Local: Pouso Alegre, MG Modelo : 100% presencial Reporta-se a : Gerente Senior de Planta e Gerente Sr. H&S LATAM Como Gerente de EHS você será responsável por coordenar, implantar e implementar a estratégia de EHS no Brasil para uma planta de produção com 600 funcionários e um armazém de distribuição 70 funcionários. Você deverá construir, em conjunto com o Gerente de Planta, uma cultura de EHS robusta, garantindo zero lesões e doenças, zero impactos negativos ao meio ambiente e o correto cumprimento das regulamentações da empresa e do país, seguindo os padrões industriais globais e garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a prevenção de riscos. Responsabilidades Desenvolver estratégias de EHS: Criar e implementar planos para melhorar o desempenho de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente nas unidades, alinhando com diretrizes corporativas e regulamentações locais. Treinamento e capacitação: Promover o desenvolvimento de recursos locais (técnicos e engenheiros), criando uma rede integrada e programas de treinamento eficazes. Gestão de conformidade: Garantir total conformidade com normas legais e regulamentares (NRs, IBAMA, ANVISA, entre outros) e liderar respostas a auditorias e órgãos externos. Gestão de riscos: Coordenar a execução de ferramentas como análises de risco, auditorias, JSA e mapas de risco, assegurando operações seguras e sustentáveis. Administração de projetos e contratos: Participar de processos de compras, gestão de contratos e orçamentos, garantindo execução financeira eficiente e alinhada às diretrizes de compliance. Inovação e mudanças: Liderar a gestão de mudanças relacionadas a projetos e operações, assegurando segurança, sustentabilidade e alinhamento estratégico. Qualificações Nível Superior concluído, preferencialmente em Engenharia, com Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do trabalho. Inglês avançado Sólida experiência como gestor da área de Segurança e Meio Ambiente em ambiente fabril, com vivência em melhoria contínua e experiência em implantação de sistema de gestão ambiental, saúde e segurança. Conhecimento da legislação brasileira, com entendimento dos regulamentos da OSHA/EPA. Desejável Espanhol avançado Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

title: Electrical/Electronic Engineering Analyst (R&D)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical/Electronic Engineering Analyst (R&D) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: We are seeking an Electrical\ Electronic Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. This role will work with project design, product development, product and components validation testing, testing of electrical and electronic software-controlled systems for new products and current products improvement, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The professional will collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, cost reductions initiatives, and multifunctional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and cost-competitive products. Responsibilities: Develop and refine the design of electrical\ Electronic components to support scalable and efficient product manufacturing. Collaborate closely with headquarters' R&D, suppliers to develop and qualify electrical components, ensuring alignment with production requirements. Provide technical support to manufacturing processes related to electrical and electronic components, facilitating smooth and efficient production. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on optimizing product quality and cost, ensuring product reliability, cost competitiveness, and customer satisfaction. Analyze and support the resolution of electrical issues encountered both on the production line and in the field. Electrical Components Technology Research, develop features according to the habits and needs of Brazilian users. Perform electrical testing, validation, and troubleshooting to guarantee compliance with safety standards and technical specifications. Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, including schematics, test procedures, and reports. Work closely with multifunctional teams - including mechanical, software, quality, and manufacturing - to integrate electrical systems effectively. Liaise with suppliers and external partners to source components and resolve technical challenges. Software features development for the Brazilian market, including developing innovative functions based on local user needs and modifying control software for different product models. Electrical control software technology research, developing software functions and control strategies tailored to the habits and needs of Brazilian users. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field. Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment. Proficiency with electrical design software (e.G., CAD, simulation tools) and testing equipment. Strong knowledge of electrical safety standards and product certification processes. Analytical and proactive mindset with strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Willingness to travel as necessary. Differentials: Experience in the home appliance, durable goods industries. Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development. Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management. Advanced English proficiency.

title: Analista De Negócios Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Negócios Pleno em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. A BYD (Build Your Dreams ) é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que tem a missão de criar inovações tecnológicas para uma vida melhor. Fundada em 1995, contamos com mais de 30 parques industriais e estamos presentes em mais de 70 países, provendo excelência nas indústrias de eletrônicos, automóveis, energia limpa e transporte. A BYD está comprometida com o desenvolvimento sustentável com seus valores de excelência, pragmatismo, paixão e inovação na promoção da geração de energia, armazenamento eficiente e mobilidade elétrica. Estamos presentes no Brasil desde 2015, com unidades em Campinas, São Paulo, Manaus e agora em Camaçari. Nós nos dedicamos à fabricação de painéis solares, baterias e chassis de ônibus elétricos, e em breve a produção de automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na nossa fábrica em Camaçari, na Bahia. Comercializamos também automóveis, caminhões, furgões, máscaras descartáveis e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de termos um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo, onde forneceremos trens e sistemas para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô de São Paulo. Se você, assim como a gente, é prático, objetivo, inovador, apaixonado pelo que faz e focado em excelência, venha se juntar ao nosso time e faça parte da construção de um futuro mais verde! Então, você se encaixa neste perfil? /nGraduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação/MBA é diferencial). Experiência sólida em compras, sourcing e gestão de fornecedores, preferencialmente em ambiente multinacional. Conhecimento em estratégias de Conteúdo Local e análise de mercado, com foco em redução de custos e competitividade. Domínio de processos de procurement e ferramentas digitais (ERP como SAP, Oracle). Inglês avançado (mandatório);
Habilidades estratégicas e de negociação, com capacidade de atuar em projetos complexos e multiculturais. Analisar tendências de mercado e políticas de Conteúdo Local, consolidando informações estratégicas para decisões assertivas. Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vida e promovendo melhoria contínua na performance. Atuar na gestão de processos financeiros e resolução de questões com fornecedores, assegurando agilidade e conformidade. Identificar riscos operacionais e propor soluções inovadoras, apoiando iniciativas de digitalização e transformação na área de suprimentos. Garantir transparência e equidade nos processos de gestão de fornecedores, fortalecendo a governança corporativa. Padronizar e otimizar processos de compras internacionais, assegurando eficiência e compliance em operações globais.

title: Salesforce Tpm Analyst

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD. Required Skills & Experience - 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.
- Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.
- Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.
- Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.
- Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability. Nice to Have Skills & Experience - CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.
- Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).
- AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).
- Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.G., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).
- Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks. Job Description The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.
- Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.
- Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.
- Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.
- Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.” - Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions;
escalate with context and options, not just problems.
- Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.
- Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.
- Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake).
- Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.
- Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.
- Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.
- Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.Com.

Job Information
  • Job Function: Medical Affairs Group

  • Location(s): Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil;

Job Description

We are searching for the best talent for a Junior Immunology Medical Science Liaison, based in Recife or Salvador. The MSL Mission is to, through customized interactions, discuss our treatments with physicians and other customers to shape behaviors and support informed decision making whilst identifying and bringing medical insights into the organization as inputs to medical strategy.

Main Activities
  • Build relationships with community and academic HCPs focusing on changing medical behavior through the exchange of scientific knowledge
  • Convey the value of the attributes related to the innovation (e.G., efficacy, safety, effectiveness, adherence, QoL) to gain attribute endorsement with stakeholders

  • Identify potential sites and support site recruitment when needed in alignment with the TA Head/Senior medical manager
  • Execute Medical Field Educational Events focused on pipeline close to launch and key in‑line products
  • Gather insights from field interactions regarding scientific knowledge, treatment paradigms, competitors, medical needs and opportunities
  • Draw and execute the territory and KOL engagement plan according to the strategy and validated by the other MAF stakeholders
Qualifications
  • Scientific background (Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical, Health or Biological science based university degree)
  • Technical English
  • Available to travel 75% of time
  • Safe Fleet requirements: valid type B driver’s license and at least 3 years of driving experience, preferably in highway zones (80–110 km/h) with standard vehicles
Preferred Skills
  • Analytical Reasoning

description:

Top Skills' Details 1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations. 2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development). 3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery. 3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred). 4.) Hands on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs. Job Description: Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems. The Role We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‑stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications. You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation. Key Responsibilities Enterprise System Integration Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, NetSuite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms. AWS Engineering & Architecture Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns. Full‑Stack Development Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes. Advanced Development & Data Workflows Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization. Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies. Qualifications Required Technical Skills 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures. Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‑native applications. Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.). Soft Skills Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams. Preferred Skills Experience with EventBridge, AppFlow, or enterprise iPaaS tools. Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

description:

Procuramos um(a) Executivo(a) Negócios Novos para realizar vendas, garantindo o cumprimento das metas comerciais estabelecidas e promovendo a integração da empresa com o mercado. Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência! Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições: Fazer o mapeamento do mercado de acordo com a área de atuação da unidade e nível de aderência do cliente às nossas soluções. Atuar como hunter com foco em clientes de médio a grande porte nos segmentos de serviços, agronegócios, indústria, varejo, atacado e distribuição. Atender leads gerados pela área de outbound e atuar com prospecção de novos clientes alinhados com a estratégia de negócios e metas estabelecidas pela unidade. Alimentar o CRM conforme evolução de sua atuação, para garantir a gestão de pipeline e forecasts no sistema. Realizar apresentação da solução com ênfase na necessidade do prospect, transmitindo o diferencial do software para o mesmo. Conduzir a negociação de modo a sustentar relações rentáveis e positivas para a empresa e para os clientes. Elaborar propostas no sistema e fazer follow up com o cliente até o fechamento. Participar de eventos para verificar tendências, fortalecer o networking e identificar oportunidades de novos negócios. Realizar acompanhamento das negociações, verificando status da implantação e garantindo a satisfação do cliente. Requisitos e qualificações: Superior Completo em: Administração, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e correlatos;
Experiência com vendas consultivas na área de tecnologia e sistemas;
CNH B, Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para viagens para atender a região do Sul de Minas. title: Desenvolvedor Php Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Php Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. DESAFIO Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web utilizando ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, e outras tecnologias relacionadas. Implementar e otimizar soluções utilizando HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, e JSon, garantindo alta performance e usabilidade. Desenvolver e manter banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo a criação e otimização de triggers, stored procedures e aplicação de regras de normalização. Integrar e consumir WebServices (SOAP e REST) nas aplicações desenvolvidas. Controlar as mudanças no desenvolvimento de software para assegurar a estabilidade e evolução contínua dos projetos. Identificar e corrigir problemas no código, bem como propor melhorias e oportunidades de refatoração para manter a qualidade do software. Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócios e qualidade. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade e maturidade de software. Experiência e conhecimento em Linguagem de programação: domínio de aplicação e entendimento de sintaxe e desempenho de linguagens como ASP.NET c#, Java script, Json, Bootstrap Experiência com WEB JS/Jquery/Ajax, Webforms, Bootstrap, HTML, JSon e CSS, SQL Server, incluindo normalização, triggers, e stored procedures. Conhecimento em SOAP e REST. Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes. Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes. VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER Experiência prévia no mercado de corretoras de seguros. O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ ️ Auxílio Alimentação : para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos. Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. Assistência Médica SulAmérica : Cuidado completo para você e sua família.
