Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem somos? Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
Experiência de2+ anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
Experiência de2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;
Experiência de2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;
Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;
Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
Conhecimento sólido emGit e versionamento de código;
Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa. Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
Experiência nasustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);
Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents. O que oferecemos? Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
6 dias de folga anuais+ folga de aniversário;
Bônus de indicação;
Bônus de equipe;
Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
Horários flexíveis;
Autonomia parapropor e implementar novas tecnologias! Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

Descrição da vaga A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes. Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes. Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos. Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI). Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente. Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas. Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções. Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders. Requisitos e qualificações: Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning. Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas). Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI). Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas. Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL). Diferenciais: Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT). Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines. Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Flutter em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company: Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively. Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression. Role Description: Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life. Deliverables: Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end. Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences. Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed. Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence. Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets. Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability. Requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs. 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.Js, with a strong understanding of design patterns. Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.G., MVC, MVVM). Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures. Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools. Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.G., Jest, Gatling, Playwright). Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment. Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment. Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned. BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Nice to have: Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows. Experience with AWS and working with databases. Experience with SDUI and CI/CD. Experience with flutter_bloc. Perks: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment! Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Engenheiro Ia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Ia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Duties and Responsibilities: - Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.
- Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.
- Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.
- Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.
- Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa. Minimum Qualifications/Experience: - Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.
- Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.
- Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.
- Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.
- Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.
- Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos. Minimum Education: Ensino superior completo. Inglês Fluente

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers specializing in Go. This role is for engineers with strong backend experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems, and following best practices. What You’ll Do - Build and maintain scalable backend services using Go.
- Deploy and manage microservices with Kubernetes.
- Manage CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth deployments.
- Own backend architecture, driving best practices and high-quality code.
- Optimize backend performance for reliability and scalability. What We’re Looking For - Strong experience building backend systems in Go .
- Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB).
- Proficiency with Kubernetes and containerized distributed applications.
- Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Familiarity with microservices, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems. Nice to have - Experience with frontend development.
- Experience working in a remote environment. Why Join Kake? Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination. The icing on the Kake: Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally. Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you. Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions. ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good. Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Cientista De Dados - Machine Learning
description:

Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho. Responsabilidades: - Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Cientista De Dados - Machine Learning
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista De Dados - Machine Learning em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho. Responsabilidades: - Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.
- Trabalho com Linguagens e Bibliotecas: Utilizar Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas e numpy, além de frameworks de NLP para desenvolver soluções eficientes e escaláveis.

- Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura em Cloud: Atuar em ambientes de computação em nuvem, especialmente utilizando AWS, S3, SageMaker e Glue, para otimizar processos de dados e Machine Learning.
- Arquitetura de Soluções: Projetar e implementar soluções end-to-end, criando pipelines analíticos e integrando modelos em ambientes produtivos para maximizar a eficiência operacional. Além das habilidades técnicas, o candidato deve possuir competências profissionais como comunicação técnica clara, autonomia para tomar decisões e a capacidade de atuar em contextos de negócios complexos. Se você é apaixonado por dados e tecnologia, e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica que valoriza a inovação, se inscreva!

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.


Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this highly autonomous role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Partner with research, sales, and client stakeholders to translate business objectives into clear analytical approaches, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Lead end-to-end scoping, including framing business questions, defining hypotheses, and recommending appropriate methodologies.
  • Act as the primary analytics interface in Brazil, effectively collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and building strong, trusted relationships.
  • Provide consultative guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from early-stage solutioning through final delivery and interpretation.
  • Serve as a lead analytics practitioner, independently designing and executing advanced quantitative methodologies, including segmentation, brand tracking, pricing and elasticity modeling, conjoint and MaxDiff, ad and concept testing, claims substantiation, driver analysis, media mix modeling, and attribution.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of analytical projects, ensuring methodological rigor, quality, and business relevance.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights, with strong storytelling tailored to senior stakeholders by clearly explaining the mechanics behind models and analytical approaches, ensuring transparency and stakeholder confidence in results.
  • Design and develop AI-enabled analytics solutions (e.G., analytical agents, automated insight generation, decision support tools) leveraging LLMs or similar technologies.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can enhance productivity and insight quality across data preparation, modeling, validation, and reporting.
  • Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to operationalize solutions at scale, ensuring repeatability and efficiency.
  • Champion automation and standardization, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across engagements.
  • Support the development and adoption of AI governance practices, including responsible use guidelines, bias detection and mitigation, and documentation standards.
  • Ensure all analytical and AI-driven outputs maintain high standards of quality, transparency, and ethical integrity.
  • Balance innovation with rigor, ensuring new approaches are credible, defensible, and client-ready.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles, ideally in a client-facing or consulting environment.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects end-to-end, from scoping and problem framing through delivery, including stakeholder management and quality control.
  • Demonstrated ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders (e.G., research, sales, clients), translating business needs into analytical solutions.
  • Fluency in English is required;
    additional languages (particularly Portuguese/Spanish) are a strong plus.


**Please submit your CV in English


Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal vouchers, transportation vouchers, and language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

01 About the role

We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.


02 What you'll own

  • Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack.
  • Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86).
  • Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes.
  • Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS.
  • Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware.
  • WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime.
  • Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures.
  • Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.


03 What you bring

MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux.
  • Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree.
  • Yocto or Buildroot.
  • OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions.
  • GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante.
  • Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image.
  • Shell, C/C++, Git.
  • Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.

NICE BONUS SIGNAL

  • WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK.
  • Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack.
  • Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign.
  • Docker, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra.
  • Rust or Python.
  • Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS.
  • Security hardening / secure boot.


04 The kind of engineer this work asks for

  • Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads.
  • Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape.
  • Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for


APPLY

Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. Requisitos e qualificações Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

O Padeiro atua como garantidor da qualidade, segurança alimentar e eficiência operacional da padaria, assegurando que cada item chegue ao cliente com o padrão de frescor e apresentação exigido pela Emporyum Prime. Responsabilidades Principais Gestão de Insumos ● Receber, conferir e armazenar pães congelados e demais insumos de padaria, respeitando as temperaturas e prazos de validade indicados pelos fornecedores ● Organizar o estoque seguindo o princípio PVPS (Primeiro que Vence, Primeiro que Sai), garantindo a rotatividade adequada dos produtos ● Registrar lotes e datas de recebimento para rastreabilidade e controle sanitário Processo Produtivo ● Conduzir o processo de fermentação natural e câmara de crescimento, respeitando os tempos, temperaturas e condições ambientais especificados para cada tipo de massa ● Operar fornos industriais com precisão nos parâmetros de temperatura, umidade e tempo de assamento ● Monitorar indicadores visuais e sensoriais (coloração, textura, aroma) para garantir o ponto ideal de cada fornada antes da disponibilização para venda Produção Diversificada ● Elaborar salgados assados e fritos (coxinhas, empadas, esfihas, quibes, folheados) seguindo receituário padrão e especificações de peso e formato ● Produzir doces de padaria (bolos, tortas, biscoitos, sonhos, brigadeiros, pudins) com consistência de sabor, textura e apresentação ● Executar decoração básica e finalização de produtos confeitados para vitrine Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Perdas ● Realizar inventário diário de insumos e produtos acabados, registrando entradas, saídas e quebras ● Monitorar e reportar o KPI de perda (percentual de desperdício sobre produção total), propondo ações corretivas quando o indicador ultrapassar o limite estabelecido ● Identificar produtos próximos ao vencimento e acionar a área comercial para estratégias de giro rápido (promoções, combos, doações internas) Exposição ● Repor e organizar as gôndolas e vitrines de venda, garantindo sortimento visual equilibrado e exposição atrativa dos produtos ● Manter etiquetas de preço, informações de validade e identificação de alergênicos visíveis e atualizados ● Assegurar que a área de padaria esteja limpa, organizada e em conformidade com as normas sanitárias (ANVISA/BPF) durante todo o horário de funcionamento Requisitos e Habilidades Desejadas Escolaridade ● Ensino fundamental completo (obrigatório) ● Curso técnico em Panificação, Confeitaria ou Gastronomia (desejável) Experiência ● Mínimo de 1 ano em funções de padaria, panificação ou confeitaria ● Experiência comprovada com fermentação natural, fornos industriais e produção em escala ● Vivência em estabelecimentos de alimentação com alto padrão de qualidade (diferencial) Habilidades Essenciais Competência Por que é importante Organização e disciplina operacional O processo produtivo exige sequenciamento preciso de etapas (fermentação, modelagem, assamento) — um desvio quebra o fluxo e compromete a disponibilidade de produtos na loja Atenção a normas sanitárias A manipulação direta de alimentos exige rigor absoluto com higiene, temperaturas e boas práticas de fabricação para garantir a segurança do consumidor e a conformidade legal Capacidade de trabalho sob pressão O ritmo de produção é determinado pela demanda da loja — horários de pico exigem agilidade sem abrir mão da qualidade Precisão e consistência técnica Cada fornada deve reproduzir o padrão estabelecido — variações em peso, ponto de cozimento ou apresentação afetam diretamente a experiência do cliente e a margem de perda Proatividade e senso de dono O Padeiro é o guardião do estoque e do desperdício — antecipar necessidades de insumos e agir sobre produtos próximos ao vencimento reduz perdas e melhora a rentabilidade Diferenciais ● Conhecimento em confeitaria fina e decoração de bolos ● Experiência com massas especiais (fermentação longa, massa madre, integrais, sem glúten) ● Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis (incluindo finais de semana e feriados) ● CNH categoria A ou B (para eventual deslocamento entre unidades) ● Curso de Boas Práticas de Fabricação e Manipulação de Alimentos atualizado

Proficiência em Pythonvoltado para desenvolvimento de pacotes, classes reutilizáveis e testes unitários independentes;
Conhecimento em conceitos de governança de dados (Metadados, Catálogo, Linhagem, Controle de Acesso). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia na implementação de Feature Stores do zero (ex: Feast, Databricks Feature Store);

title: Desenvolvedor Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us CUB specializes in automating receivables and post-sales for Brazilian land developments. Our technology enhances efficiency, reduces delinquency, and offers strategic insights for better decision-making. About the role As a Senior Software Developer, you'll join a growing startup with a strong focus on learning and teamwork. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while you help to improve automation for land developments in Brazil. Your role as a senior member will be crucial in guiding our tech efforts and making a real difference in a supportive environment. What you'll do Crafting production-ready, shippable code with a strong emphasis on clean code principles. Implement and refine testing strategies for unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality, continuously monitoring system health for reliability and performance. Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, and effectively communicating solutions to the team. Work in the DevOps field to provision, configure, and manage infrastructure with Terraform, and automate deployment pipelines for CI/CD workflows. Stay informed on emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation and enhance efficiency, while identifying and evaluating open-source and market solutions. This involves discerning when to integrate external services or pursue in-house development, optimizing our development process. Design and maintain asynchronous job processing and workflow orchestration solutions using tools such as Temporal or Inngest. Explore and implement AI-powered features, automations, and developer workflows, including integrations with LLMs, AI agents, and modern AI tooling when relevant to the business. Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Minimum professional experience of 5 years in software development, with a deep focus on Node.Js and TypeScript, proficiency in building RESTful APIs, web services and microservices using frameworks like Nest.Js or Express.Js Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, including deployment, management, and optimization of cloud resources. Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows or integrating AI services and APIs is a strong plus.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact

  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Airline Captain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Airline Captain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Captain A320

✈️ Full-Time

An international airline is seeking an experienced A320 Captain to lead flight operations and ensure the safe, secure, and efficient management of commercial aircraft operations. The role offers the opportunity to operate within a rapidly growing global aviation network with strong career progression opportunities.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall command of the aircraft, leading flight and cabin crew, and maintaining the highest safety and operational standards throughout all phases of flight.

Role Overview

The A320 Captain holds ultimate responsibility for the safe operation of the aircraft, crew, passengers, and cargo. The role requires strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and the ability to maintain operational efficiency while adhering to strict safety and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Flight Command & Safety

  • Maintain full command of the aircraft from taxi-out through to final engine shutdown
  • Ensure the safety and security of passengers, crew, cargo, and aircraft at all times
  • Operate the aircraft in compliance with aviation regulations and company procedures

Crew Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate flight and cabin crew throughout the flight
  • Demonstrate strong crew resource management and effective decision-making
  • Maintain high standards of professionalism and operational discipline

Operational Performance

  • Deliver consistent on-time performance and reliable flight operations
  • Manage flight efficiency in line with environmental and fuel policies
  • Ensure all flight operations align with organisational safety and service standards

Requirements

Candidates must meet the following criteria:

  • Minimum 5,500 total flying hours
  • Minimum 2,500 Pilot-in-Command (PIC) hours on multi-crew glass cockpit aircraft
  • Minimum 1,500 PIC hours on the A320 family
  • A320 family aircraft flown within the last 12 months
  • Valid A320 type rating with at least two months validity at the time of joining
  • Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL
  • Current Class 1 medical certificate
  • English language proficiency level 4 or higher

Additional consideration may be given to candidates who are current TRE or TRI instructors .

Note: For flights involving inflight relief, 75% of the total hours may count toward minimum hour requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

This role includes a competitive compensation package designed to support pilots and their families, including:

  • Tax-free salary package with base salary and flying pay
  • Housing allowance
  • Layover and meal allowances
  • Performance-based salary increments
  • Education allowance for dependent children
  • Income protection scheme
  • Life and accident insurance
  • End-of-service benefits
  • Staff travel privileges and airline discounts
  • 42 days of annual leave

Total annual compensation may reach approximately USD $181,000 depending on flying hours and allowances .
